root.text: Rain beads along Corvus's tarred oilskin as he eyes your fractured brass tally. 'Unstamped, eh? The Chancery Auditors hate a broken number. Walk soft, traveler, and speak to Clerk Maren in the Customs Hall if you want to stay out of the Ash-Quarry.'

choices.label: Ask what happened to the old Ferry crossing.
Offer to recover his stolen ferry-charm from the Drowned Piers.
Return his consecrated oar charm freely.

lore_crossing.text: 'Centuries back, a dead soul crossed the Mist-Weir and stepped into Quiet. Then the Chancery bolted brass scales across the river and started taxing memory like coal. Some of us still remember the Quiet Oar.'

addJournalKnowledge.title: The Quiet Oar
addJournalKnowledge.text: Before Chancery coins and smoke, a simple wooden oar carried the dead to rest.

start_oar.text: 'Black-Ledger cutthroats jumped my apprentice on the Drowned Piers and took my blessed oar-charm. Clear them out and bring it back, and I will share what I know of the Threshold.'

choices.label: I will search the Drowned Piers.

return_oar_good.text: Corvus clasps your wrist with calloused fingers. 'Honesty is rarer than quiet in Weir-Port. Keep the Charm of the Quiet Oar; it strengthens any invocation you cast.'

root.text: Clerk Maren glances past the swaying ash-lamps before leaning across her ink-stained desk. 'Your tally cracked on the weir. Keep it hidden! If an Auditor logs you as Unstamped, they will bind you to the Cinder Foundries for fifty years.'

choices.label: Ask where you can learn the truth about your broken tally.
[Positive Morality] Ask if the Quiet Reformers need help smuggling quarry families.

point_archives.text: 'Go to Chief Archivist Solene in the Audit Archives. Tell her Maren sent you. And take care around Baron Vane's men in the Brass-Works.'

choices.label: I will seek out Archivist Solene.

start_pos_sanctuary.text: Maren exhales in relief. 'Word of your mercy reached the clerks' hall. Take these stamped sanctuary writs to Prior Aldous in Bellwright Square before the bailiffs raid the Penitent Camp.'

choices.label: I will deliver them safely to Prior Aldous.

root.text: 'Steel, oilskin, whetstones, and foundry kits! Nothing stamped by the Chancery, everything paid in honest coin.'

rumor.text: 'Furnace Baron Vane doubled ash-quotas again. Half the quarry crew is ready to strike at Penitent's Camp.'

root.text: Bram ladles steaming barley broth into a tin mug. 'Warm hearth, no Auditors at the door. Rest your bones here whenever Weir-Port turns ugly.'

choices.label: [Foreclosure of the Docks] Demand the delinquent boardinghouse contracts for Vespera Null.

foreclose_bram.text: Bram's jaw hardens as you lay Vespera's black wax writ on the counter. 'So you sold your spine to the Black-Ledger. Take the slips and get out of my house!'

root.text: Vespera turns a black wax seal between gloved fingers. 'Sentiment buys no fuel in Vesper-Threshold, traveler. Only leverage.'

choices.label: [Negative Morality] Ask about profitable Black-Ledger work.

start_neg_foreclosure.text: Vespera smiles thinly. 'Finally, someone who grasps arithmetic. Go to the Salt-Wick Boardinghouse, seize Bram's delinquent debtor slips, and bring them here for your cut.'

finish_neg_foreclosure.text: 'Clean, swift, and profitable. Take your coin and this Black-Ledger ring. If your ruthlessness deepens, Lord-Auctioneer Kestrel in the Velvet Court has an even larger contract.'

root.text: Rooks tips his soot-stained cap beneath the blue cistern lamps. 'Need lockpicks, salt-cloaks, or a quiet fence for dockside finds?'

choices.label: Sell Corvus's river charm to the Freebooters instead of returning it.

fence_oar.text: Rooks whistles low and counts out heavy silver. 'Smart move, friend. Sentiment never bought a warm coat.'

morality.reason: Sold Corvus's river charm to smugglers

root.text: Baron Vane wipes brass spectacles against his coat. 'Everyone curses the Cinder Foundries until the city lanterns flicker out and the Pale Reach creeps over the walls. Are you here to preach, or to be useful?'

choices.label: Take Vane's hush-gold to leave the quarry strike broken.

baron_deal.text: 'Pragmatism! Here is your retainer. Tell Dara Iron-Palm the kilns do not stop for tears.'

morality.reason: Accepted Baron Vane's hush-gold over the quarry laborers

root.text: Solene closes a towering iron ledger with a muted thud. 'So you are the Unstamped arrival Maren whispered about. Your shattered tally matches a pre-Chancery numeral from before the First Scale was forged.'

choices.label: Ask what the Chancery is hiding in the Cinder Foundries.
Ask about the Chancery Scales riddle.

start_arc2.text: 'Crack the Magistrate Ledger-Safe here in the Archives and confront Foreman Krag at the Smoking Cinder Kilns. Prove the Furnace Guild is staging border losses to harvest soul-ash, then bring the proof to Magistrate Lyra!'

choices.label: I will expose the Ledgers of Smoke.

clue_scales.text: 'Every Chancery vault lock honors the twin-panned Brass Scale. Remember that emblem when testing the archive tumblers.'

addJournalKnowledge.title: Emblem of the Brass Scale
addJournalKnowledge.text: The Chancery's locks and decrees are keyed to the Brass Scale.

root.text: 'Every coin struck here weighs exactly one grain of stamped brass. Buy what you need and keep your hands off the presses.'

dlg_al_prior_aldous.speaker: Prior Aldous of the Last Bell

root.text: A soft bronze chime echoes across the square as Prior Aldous bows. 'Peace to your memory, wayfarer. The Order of the Last Bell believes rest should never be bought on credit.'

choices.label: Deliver Consecrated Bell-Bronze & Fulgurite Ash-Quartz for the Seventh Bell.
Deliver Clerk Maren's sanctuary writs for the quarry families.
Ask about the legend of the Thirteenth Chime.

start_bell.text: 'Bring me Consecrated Bell-Bronze and Fulgurite Ash-Quartz from the Reach, and our Seventh Bell will toll calm across the lower city.'

finish_bell.text: 'Magnificent alloy! Take this Mantle of Quiet with the gratitude of the Order.'

finish_pos_sanctuary.text: Prior Aldous places a hand over the sealed writs. 'Thirty indebted souls will sleep beyond the kilns tonight because you chose mercy over coin. Take Maren's Reformer Pin and our blessing.'

clue_quiet.text: 'Twelve chimes count the Chancery's shifts. The thirteenth belongs to Quiet, the true rest no ledger can tax.'

addJournalKnowledge.title: The First Quiet
addJournalKnowledge.text: The thirteenth silent chime represents Quiet, the peace no tax can claim.

root.text: "Keep your lamp low down here! Ash-hounds nest by the warm grates, and Freebooter Rooks runs the hidden cistern just south of the sluice. If you need nimble fingers for locked strongboxes or a sharp blade in the alleys, I can watch your back."

choices.label: "Travel with me, Pem. I could use a lockbreaker and scout."

recruit_pem.text: Pem grins and checks a pair of slim pick-wires tucked in his cuff. "Lead the way, Unstamped. Just promise we keep clear of the Bailiffs' cages!"

root.text: Magistrate Lyra looks out over the soot-blackened Lower City. 'The Chancery was founded to keep the Threshold from crumbling, not to turn souls into lamp-oil for immortal patricians.'

choices.label: Present the Black-Ink Expenditure Ledger & Krag's downfall.
Show Magistrate Lyra all three recovered fragments of the First Seal.
Present the Pre-Chancery River Charter from the Drowned Piers.

finish_arc2.text: 'You have proved what High Auditor Crassus denied for decades! Yet he still holds the First Seal chained in the Threshold Abyss. Cross Lantern-Wall Bastion into the Pale Reach and recover the three Seal Fragments: Passage, Memory, and Quiet.'

choices.label: I will cross into the Pale Reach.

finish_hidden_charter.text: Lyra stares at the ancient wax seal in stunned silence. 'This charter predates the Chancery itself! With this document, the Reformers can challenge Crassus's very right to tax the Weir!'

finish_arc3_backup.text: "All three silver arcs of the First Seal! Take them swiftly into the Threshold Abyss and confront High Auditor Crassus in the Scale Sanctum."

choices.label: I will face the First Seal.

root.text: Thousands of glass phials chime faintly behind Savant Elara. 'Every memory distilled here is a life rescued from salt-erosion. And remember, arcanist: study Lore and Investigation to earn Arcane Knowledge Points for your Grimoire.'

choices.label: Offer to retrieve Weeping Orchard Amber for the Conservatory.
Deliver Weeping Orchard Amber to Savant Elara.
Ask what survives when fire and ledgers turn to dust.

start_amber.text: 'Bring me pure Weeping Orchard Amber from the Ossuary Bastions. Tread gently around Serena; grief made her dangerous, not malice.'

choices.label: I will bring back the amber.

finish_amber.text: 'Flawless clarity! Take this Mnemonic Prism Band; it sharpens every invocation and uncovers concealed seams.'

clue_memory.text: 'When flame dies and brass corrodes, only Memory and the vows we kept endure.'

addJournalKnowledge.title: What Outlives the Flame
addJournalKnowledge.text: Memory and unbroken vows survive even after ash-flames and brass ledgers turn to dust.

root.text: Kestrel swirls pale amber wine in a crystal flute. 'Order requires fuel, and fuel requires debtors. Only idealists pretend eternity is free.'

choices.label: [Negative Morality] Inquire about the Velvet Court's private commission.

start_neg_crown.text: 'Splendid. Raid the Obsidian Toll-Coffer in the Vault of Unpaid Echoes, bring me the Condensed Sovereign Ash-Core, and the Cinder-Debt Executioner Glaive is yours.'

finish_neg_crown.text: Kestrel's eyes reflect the blinding core. 'Exquisite power! Wield the Cinder-Debt Glaive as a sovereign of ash, not a servant.'

root.text: Tomas presses his palm against the vibrating brass frame. 'Twelve hammers strike for the Auditors. Find the thirteenth gear-key and speak the word of rest, and the tower reveals what Crassus hid inside.'
Dara wraps soot-blackened knuckles in linen. 'Baron Vane sent iron automatons into the Ash-Quarry to crush our strike. Stand with us, traveler, and we will never forget it.'

choices.label: Promise to break the Quarry Strikebreakers.
Tell Dara the Strikebreakers are broken or the Foundry flue is vented.

start_strike.text: 'Vent the Foundry pressure wheel or smash the strikebreaker squad in the Great Ash-Quarry, then come back to me.'

finish_strike_good.text: Dara lets out a fierce laugh. 'You broke Vane's iron bullies! The quarry workers stand with the Quiet Reformers now!'

morality.reason: Defended the Ash-Quarry laborers against Furnace strikebreakers

root.text: 'I only keep the ore tallies! If you are looking for pale-iron veins, check the collapsed chalk drift on the east wall.'
"Keep low on the viaduct! Crystallized salt-jackals and shard-kites rush the beacons whenever the fog drops. If you are pushing out into the Pale Reach or the Amber-Vein Catacombs, my bow is yours."

choices.label: "Come with me, Fenn. Two pairs of eyes beat the salt-fog."

recruit_fenn.text: Fenn slings a salt-iron quiver tight across his shoulder and salutes crisply. "Glad to march beside someone who actually checks their corners. Lead on!"

root.text: Captain Voss rests a gloved hand on her lantern-halberd. 'Beyond this bastion lies the Pale Reach. No Chancery writ protects you out there, only sharp eyes and sharper steel.'

choices.label: Offer to clear the raiders off the Rusted Viaduct.
Report that the Rusted Viaduct beacons are secure.
Deliver the Secret Auditor-Furnace Pact from the Clockwork Belfry.

start_viaduct.text: 'Clear the salt-jackal raid off the Rusted Viaduct and I will outfit you from the Bastion armory.'

finish_viaduct.text: 'Clean work! Take this Lantern-Wall Kettle Helm and the respect of the Pale Frontier Wardens.'

finish_hidden_pact.text: Voss reads the wax-sealed pact, her face turning pale with fury. 'Crassus traded my rangers' blood for Furnace longevity shares! The Pale Wardens will march on the Chancery when you move on the First Seal. Take my Fulgurite Arc-Bow!'

root.text: Yarrow balances a flat salt-stone on a trembling stack. 'Three ancient charms lie scattered across the Viaduct, the Salt-Flats, and the Whispering Mire. Gather the Triad and you shall hear the old ferry bell.'

finish_pale_ferry.text: As you lay the Bone, Glass, and Silver charms atop the cairn, a phantom timber barge glides silently through the white fog, tolling a single silver bell of peace. Yarrow presses the Locket of the Unforgotten into your palm.

morality.reason: Honored the forgotten souls of the Pale Ferry

root.text: 'Amber varnish, memory-salves, and shroudweave! The Chancery calls us monsters out here, yet their own apothecaries buy my roots in secret.'

Calen's porcelain mask tilts thoughtfully beneath the ossuary arches. 'We were once magistrates, clerks, and wardens like any in the city, until Crassus branded us Unwritten to hide his crimes. Do you bring parley, or war?'

choices.label: Request a formal parley with the Unwritten Court.
Pledge fair truce and ask Regent Malcor for the Fragment of Memory.

start_truce.text: 'Speak truthfully, traveler. If you swear to end Crassus's ledger-tyranny rather than hunt exiles, Regent Malcor will entrust you with the Fragment of Memory without bloodshed.'

choices.label: I will honor a truce with the Unwritten.

grant_truce.text: 'Then let no blood stain the Hollow Nave today. Take the Fragment of Memory, and remember that monsters are often made by the empires that fear them.'

morality.reason: Forged a peaceful truce with the Court of the Unwritten

root.text: Golden tears glint along Serena's crystalline armor. 'I kept my oath to the refugees the Chancery left to freeze. Why do you disturb this orchard?'

choices.label: [Positive Morality] Speak gently and offer to perform the Rite of Quiet for her fallen.
Complete the Rite of Quiet with Serena.
Step respectfully back among the glass trees.

start_mercy_vow.text: Serena lowers her halberd in quiet wonder. 'You carry no taint of the Auction Court. Stay and speak the Rite of Quiet beside me, so my watch may finally end in peace.'

choices.label: Speak the Rite of Quiet now.

finish_mercy_vow.text: The amber shell around Serena's shoulders melts into warm light. 'Thank you, Lantern of Mercy. Take my Vow-Bound Sabre of Quiet and remind the Threshold what honor looks like.'

root.text: The translucent Architect gazes out over the dry riverbed of floating ash. 'Every empire built on stolen breath claims it alone holds back the dark. What truth have you carried to the Ferry-Arch?'

choices.label: Present the Silent Architect's Stone Tablet.
[Finale - Mercy] Restore the First Seal of Quiet and end forced soul-harvesting.
[Finale - Reform] Reforge the Chancery under a Humane Charter of Consent.
[Finale - Ruthless] Seize the Sovereign Scale and rule Vesper-Threshold yourself.

finish_hidden_architect.text: 'You kept both compassion and truth alive across the Ossuary. Wear the Diadem of the Seventh Bell; let your magic carry the calm of the original Seal.'

ending_quiet.text: You seat the three silver arcs into the First Seal. Across Vesper-Threshold, the furnace smoke clears, the seventh bell tolls, and the river barges finally carry weary souls into true Quiet.

morality.reason: Restored the First Seal of Quiet

choices.label: Watch the dawn break over the Mist-Weir.

ending_reform.text: You reforge the Seal into an open compact of consent. Magistrate Lyra and Captain Voss abolish debt-forfeiture, turning Vesper-Threshold into a free refuge between worlds.

ending_seize.text: You bind the First Seal to your own ledger. The brass lanterns flare blinding gold as the Furnace Guild and Velvet Court kneel to a new Sovereign of Ash.

morality.reason: Seized the Sovereign Scale of Vesper-Threshold

root.text: "Mind the sparks, traveler. My cousin Orlov thinks every anvil in Vesper-Threshold belongs to the Furnace Guild, yet this hearth still burns untaxed. Need toolkits, raw billets, or a real test of artisan craft?"

choices.label: Browse your forge wares and artisan toolkits.
"You left the Furnace Guild? Tell me what you need for your forge."
"I forged a piece at the Crucible as you asked."
"What is the next step in breaking your cousin's craft monopoly?"
"I brought the Deep-Slag Pitch Cask from the Amber-Vein Catacombs."
"Tell me about this Unstamped Masterwork you mentioned."
"I have both Fulgurite-Silver and Muted Bell-Alloy. Let's forge the Masterwork!"
Ask how to imbue existing gear with material resonance (Enchanting)

open_shop.text: "Every toolkit on that rack is balanced by hand, including my Clockwork Caliper kits. Take what you need and forge something honest."

start_craft_1.text: "Good ears! Baron Vane cut off my iron charters, hoping this wharf would freeze cold. Grab some Pale-Iron or Tempered Kiln-Glass, craft ANY weapon, armor, or balm at the Forge, and show me an Unstamped hand can still outwork his guildsmen. I'll gift you my Clockwork Artifice kit in return."

finish_craft_1.text: "By the Quiet Oar, look at that temper line! Clean joinery, zero Chancery tax-stamp. Take this Clockwork Caliper Kit and my Unstamped Forge-Mark. When you're ready for deeper work, ask me about the Amber-Vein Catacombs."

choices.label: "Tell me about the Amber-Vein Catacombs now."

start_craft_2.text: "Beneath the Debt-Quarries lie the Amber-Vein Catacombs, where ancient kiln slag weeps Cinder-Pitch Resin. Tap the Ancient Pitch Cistern there, practice a field Item Combination so you know how resin and glass bind on the road, and bring the cask back. Mind the Slag-Golem."

choices.label: "I'll head down to the Amber-Vein Catacombs."

pitch_choice.text: "Rich, black-gold Deep-Slag Pitch! There is far more in that seam than my forge alone needs. What should we do with the surplus vein map?"

choices.label: "Share the surplus pitch with Dara Iron-Palm's freezing quarry families." [Mercy]
"Keep it purely for independent artisans here at the Crucible."
"Auction the exclusive vein rights to Mintmaster Gideon for a fat purse." [Toll]

finish_craft_2_mercy.text: "Spoken like a true craftsperson. Dara's folk will have warm oilskins and lamp-pitch through the cold shifts. Here are your Artificer Goggles and spare brass mainsprings."

morality.reason: Shared Amber-Vein Pitch with Quarry Families

finish_craft_2_neutral.text: "Practical and safe. The Crucible Wharf will stay stocked for every Unstamped wanderer who needs honest steel."

finish_craft_2_toll.text: Orla frowns darkly as Gideon's courier drops a heavy coin-sack onto the anvil. "I keep my bargains, so take your goggles and your gold, but I had hoped you were different from my cousin."

morality.reason: Sold Amber-Vein Rights to Mintmaster Gideon

choices.label: "Coin keeps the bellows pumping. What's next?"

start_craft_3.text: "Now for the crowning work: an Unstamped Masterwork that laughs at Chancery toll-wards. Bring me Fulgurite-Silver from the Shattered Salt-Observatory and a Muted Bell-Alloy Shard from the Crypt of the Muted Bells. Together, we'll quench a legend."

choose_masterwork.text: "Fulgurite-Silver humming beside ancient Bell-Alloy... I've waited thirty years to heat a crucible like this! Tell me what form shall leave my anvil tonight?"

choices.label: Forge the Dawn-Tempered Fulgurite Sabre (Legendary Weapon).
Forge the Sovereign Crucible Aegis-Lantern (Legendary Off-Hand).
"I still need a Muted Bell-Alloy Shard from the Crypt of the Muted Bells."

forge_blade.text: Hours pass in rhythm of hammer and quench. When you lift the Dawn-Tempered Fulgurite Sabre from the oil-bath, silver lightning dances down its fuller with a clear, unbroken bell-note!

forge_lantern.text: Hours pass as you braze bell-bronze ribs around a Fulgurite-Silver prism cage. The Sovereign Crucible Aegis-Lantern ignites without oil, shedding steady dawn-gold light that turns back both blade and despair!

explain_imbuement.text: Forging from scratch is only half the art, traveler. Open the Crafting view and switch to 'Enchant & Imbue Gear'. Lay any blade, coat, shield, or ring beside a catalyst like Chancery Quicksilver, Ash-Quartz, or Pale Reach Starlight Cinder. The material's nature reveals three resonance aspects; pick one to bind directly into your gear, up to two aspects and Rank III each.

choices.label: Thank you, Orla. Back to business.

root.text: "Peace to your ledger, wayfarer. Prior Aldous tends the living chimes, while I keep count of the bronze bells the Chancery buried alive beneath the Ossuary Bastions."

choices.label: Browse your bell-bronze and soothing balms.
"Buried bells? Tell me about the Crypt of the Muted Bells."
"I silenced the Bell-Mender and recovered the Pre-Toll Tuning-Fork."

shop.text: "Pure bronze, tallow herbs, and balm for bruised spirits. Every coin feeds the Bellhouse hospice."

start_belfry.text: "When the Auditors seized the river tolls, they chained the older mercy-bells in the Crypt of the Muted Bells and set a Brass Bell-Mender to guard their silence. If you recover the Pre-Toll Bronze Tuning-Fork from that crypt, our Order can retune Bellwright Square's ward-chimes!"

choices.label: "I will brave the Crypt of the Muted Bells."

finish_belfry.text: Cassian strikes the bronze fork gently; a luminous harmonic swells across Bellwright Square. "Listen! Even the smoke seems to lift. Wear this Chime of the Unbound Bell with our Order's gratitude."

morality.reason: Restored the Resonance of the Buried Bells

root.text: "People look down at ledgers and slag-pits and forget there was ever a sky above Vesper-Threshold. Before the chimneys choked the heavens, sailors crossed the Mist-Weir by starlight alone."

choices.label: "Is any record of that Pre-Toll sky left?"
"I recovered the Pre-Chancery Astral Star-Chart from the Salt-Observatory."

lore_hint.text: "The tower sits north of the Weeping Salt-Flats. Its silver orrery honors the stars that guided souls without tolls. If you align its rings, the lightning-condenser still yields Fulgurite-Silver!"

addJournalKnowledge.title: The Pre-Toll Sky
addJournalKnowledge.text: Astronomer Vael says the Shattered Salt-Observatory honors the Stars that guided arrivals before the Chancery rose.

start_charts.text: "Yes! My mentor sealed our last Pre-Chancery Astral Star-Chart inside a brass cylinder at the Shattered Salt-Observatory before the Auditors expelled us. Bring me that chart, and I will give you my calibrated Silver Astrolabe."

finish_charts.text: Vael unrolls the silver-inked vellum with trembling hands. "Look! The Ferryman's Crown, the Unchained Lantern, the Far-Shore Gate... they are all still there above the soot! Take my Silver Astrolabe, friend."

choices.label: "May the old stars guide us again."
